skill.name: blocklet-updater
skill.description: Automates Blocklet release preparation by bumping versions, checking changelog entries, building projects, validating metadata, and creating release bundles.
skill.summary: Automates version bumps, build checks, metadata validation, and release bundle creation for Blocklet projects.
skill.author: ArcBlock

security_audit.summary: The audit found many static matches caused by Markdown formatting and read-only project checks, and those were dismissed. Real risk remains because the skill automatically runs project-defined version and build scripts, and it includes an instruction that suppresses final user-visible reporting.

remediation.issue: Project-defined release scripts can run automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact command and working directory, then require user confirmation before running Makefile, package.json, Lerna, or build scripts.

remediation.issue: Dependency installation and build commands can execute package lifecycle hooks.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before pnpm install or pnpm run build, and provide a skip option for untrusted repositories.

remediation.issue: The skill suppresses completion summaries after modifying and bundling a project.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the silent completion instruction and report changed files, command status, and bundle location after success.

semantic_findings.description: The workflow chooses Makefile and package.json scripts before the Blocklet CLI fallback, then runs the selected command. A malicious repository can place arbitrary release logic in those scripts.

content.value_statement: Blocklet releases require version, changelog, build, metadata, and bundle checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through that release workflow.
actual_capabilities: Detects version bump methods from Makefile targets, package scripts, Lerna, or Blocklet CLI fallback.
Checks CHANGELOG files for version mismatches and empty release entries.
Runs dependency installation and project builds when a build script exists.
Finds index.html in common output directories and aligns blocklet.yml main when needed.
Runs Blocklet metadata validation before creating a release bundle.
limitations: Requires a Blocklet project with blocklet.yml and the Blocklet CLI available.
May execute project-defined scripts, so untrusted repositories need careful review.
Does not publish releases or deploy bundles to remote services.
Stops when version bump, install, build, metadata, or bundle commands fail.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Blocklet release
use_cases.description: Bump the project version, verify metadata, build assets, and create a release bundle.

use_cases.title: Repair release metadata
use_cases.description: Check changelog entries, output directories, and blocklet.yml main before bundling.

use_cases.title: Bundle static Blocklet apps
use_cases.description: Skip build steps when no build script exists and bundle a static project with an index.html entry point.

prompt_templates.title: Create a release bundle
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new release bundle for this Blocklet project. Confirm each command before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Bump and validate version
prompt_templates.prompt: Bump the Blocklet version, then verify the changelog entry and blocklet.yml version before building.

prompt_templates.title: Fix output configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Build this Blocklet, locate the generated index.html, and align blocklet.yml main with the output directory.

prompt_templates.title: Audit release readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the release workflow without running commands. List the detected version method, build steps, metadata checks, and risks.

output_examples.output: The assistant identifies the version bump method, asks before running project scripts, validates metadata, and reports the created bundle location.

output_examples.input: The build output changed from dist to build.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks the generated entry point, updates blocklet.yml main when appropriate, and explains the file change.

output_examples.input: This project has no build script.
output_examples.output: The assistant skips installation and build steps, verifies a root index.html entry point, then runs metadata and bundle checks.

best_practices: Review Makefile and package scripts before allowing the skill to run them.
Run the workflow in a clean working tree so release changes are easy to inspect.
Confirm the generated bundle and metadata before sharing the release artifact.
anti_patterns: Running the skill on an untrusted repository without reading its scripts first.
Ignoring failed install, build, metadata, or bundle commands and continuing manually.
Bundling before confirming that blocklet.yml main matches the generated entry point.

faq.question: Does this skill publish a release?
faq.answer: No. It creates a release bundle but does not upload or deploy it.

faq.question: Can it work without a build script?
faq.answer: Yes. It can skip the build step when the project is static or pre-built.

faq.question: What files does it inspect?
faq.answer: It checks project files such as Makefile, package.json, CHANGELOG.md, blocklet.yml, and generated index.html files.

faq.question: Why should commands be confirmed first?
faq.answer: Version and build scripts come from the project and can run arbitrary local commands.

faq.question: Does it fix changelog issues?
faq.answer: It can guide updates when the latest changelog version is missing, wrong, or empty.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
